verdict.rationale: Better Auth is code-configured: there are no dashboard clicks, auth lives in version control, and it ships an official CLI (`npx auth init`, schema generation and migrations) plus server-side `auth.api` methods, all of which suit scripted, non-interactive use. However, nothing documents CI or headless automation explicitly, and one hands-on report says running admin scripts and tests was 'very hacky' because of its request-header-based design. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless usage docs, documented non-interactive CLI flags for pipelines, corroboration that scripted and test usage works smoothly.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: No dashboard clicks. Your auth lives in code version controlled, type-safe, and reviewable in PRs.
To authenticate a user on the server, you can use the auth.api methods.
The CLI-generated migration made switching easy.
